findings.finding: Views supported supplied fixtures but lacked invariant-checked generation and callable processing contracts.
findings.implementation: Shared bounded rule/validation engine, explicit neutral generators, source-bound consumer descriptions, verified case corpus and v3 views with retained private source/rules.

findings.finding: A source rules file shared by two fixtures could change between preparations; the later input hash replaced the earlier pin and export succeeded with mixed rule versions.
findings.required_fix: Reject every repeated input read whose bytes differ from its first observed digest, before publication.

scope: Source and local synthetic fixtures only; installed-package qualification remains required.
